comment: Surface config for the REAL claude.ai website. Requirements: (1) network access to claude.ai — the build sandbox's egress policy blocks it (connection reset), so run this on a normal machine or CI with open egress; (2) a logged-in session for a DEDICATED TEST ACCOUNT exported to surfaces/web/storage-state.json (npx playwright codegen --save-storage=surfaces/web/storage-state.json https://claude.ai — log in, then close; never commit that file). Selectors are best-guess until calibrated: run the driver with --probe while logged in, read probe.png + the selector dump, and update below. Config-only calibration, same as the desktop surface.
